intent.raw: Vamos refinar uma pesquisa sobre os graus de liberdade do sistema, os limites da V1 e a decisão de não tornar o orquestrador recursivamente orquestrável.
intent.objective: Produce a decision-ready V1 capability envelope and evidence-gated evolution path that distinguish expressivity, authority, capability, enforcement, and proof across users, the root orchestrator, composite work, delegated agents, tools, and effect adapters.
intent.operator_sentence: Refine the research framing for system degrees of freedom.

route_menu.context_hint: The repository contains a developed root-only authority direction, an unresolved nested-orchestrator alternative, and incomplete enforcement. A useful research must connect product freedom to executable authority boundaries.

items.label: Capability envelope
items.description: Define actors, actions, phases, V1 permissions, enforcement evidence, non-delegable authority, counterexamples, and relaxation gates.
items.pattern: canonical ten-stage sequence with dialectic review

items.label: Threat model only
items.description: Study abuse and authority amplification without deciding the useful product surface; rejected as incomplete.

items.label: Permission checklist
items.description: List controls per feature without separating expressivity, authority, capability, and enforcement; rejected as too shallow.

technique_overlays.trigger: Refine requires ten owner-separated stages with explicit handoffs and validation evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes prior evidence and returns its owner-held artifact or an explicit blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: Root-only authority and bounded nested orchestration are documented competing positions, while usefulness and enforceability can pull in opposite directions.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Roles, counterclaims, convergence criteria, and stable disagreement are preserved; consensus is not manufactured.

technique_overlays.trigger: The phrase degrees of freedom hides multiple actors, resources, phases, authority owners, enforcement points, and evidence classes.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The output exposes an actor-action-phase matrix and separates declared limits from enforceable fences.

technique_overlays.trigger: Prior research, design drafts, as-built audits, and a recent unresolved contradiction materially constrain the framing.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Existing decisions are cited rather than reinvented, and proposal-only material is not promoted by repetition.

technique_overlays.trigger: A proposed capability envelope can be cheaply falsified with concrete workflows and authority-amplification scenarios.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The candidate V1 envelope admits representative useful workflows and rejects self-authorization, nested authority roots, and silent scope expansion.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The selected dialectic and Distill roles require structurally different judgments, and the repository already records a material architectural contradiction.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three read-only sibling roles independently model the product envelope, attack authority amplification and enforcement claims, and test whether the V1 remains useful. Refine owns their join, decisions, repair, and final synthesis.

roles.purpose: Construct the smallest complete actor-action-phase model and candidate current/V1/later envelope.
roles.owns: Advisory model and evidence packet only; no product decision or canonical mutation.

roles.purpose: Attack recursive authority, capability self-issuance, inherited scope, enforcement gaps, and permission claims stronger than their evidence.
roles.owns: Adversarial findings and counterexamples only; no authority decision.

roles.purpose: Test whether the proposed V1 envelope still supports representative useful workflows and whether future relaxation gates are concrete.
roles.owns: Usefulness and evolution audit only; no roadmap or scope approval.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm execution of the validated ten-stage Refine route, including three read-only subagents and local-first research?

validation: final claim and readiness audit pass

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the local evidence cannot distinguish accepted implementation, as-built evidence, formal decision, proposal, and unresolved contradiction.

steps.name: Invoke Define research problem
stop_conditions: Block if expressivity, authority, capability, enforcement, and evidence remain collapsed into one permission concept.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: The research question is answerable by named evidence and produces a decision-ready V1 envelope.
Every disagreement is either resolved, assigned to research, or preserved as decision residue.
stop_conditions: Pause for exactly one operator question if a blocker choice would materially change the research target.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Do not use external research unless a named local evidence gap appears and the operator confirms the bounded pass.

steps.name: Distill smallest coherent research unit
convergence_criteria: The selected unit is sufficient to decide a V1 capability envelope and small enough to avoid designing a general IAM platform.
stop_conditions: Block if the unit cannot recompose into product surface, authority, enforcement, and evolution decisions.

steps.name: Invoke Design research architecture
stop_conditions: Block if the design lacks an evidence matrix, scenario suite, claim ceiling, decision outputs, or owner boundaries.

steps.name: Independent design review and scenario attack
convergence_criteria: All three role receipts are present and closed.
The candidate admits useful bounded composition while rejecting scope amplification.
Unresolved architecture choices remain explicit rather than averaged.
stop_conditions: Block on any missing receipt, write-boundary breach, unsupported enforcement claim, or unhandled authority-amplification counterexample.

steps.name: Distill Repair and scenario validation
stop_conditions: Block if the repaired envelope cannot classify a scenario uniquely or if permission is treated as sufficient without enforcement evidence.

steps.name: Invoke non-executed research plan
stop_conditions: Do not execute the resulting research, mutate canonical decisions, or implement runtime controls as part of Refine.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: The final result states what the research seeks, why it matters, what it excludes, how it can fail, and which decisions it will enable.
stop_conditions: Block final pass if the result claims a settled V1 decision, implemented enforcement, or universal future expressivity without evidence.

gates.condition: The operator confirms the validated ten-stage route and the exact three-role read-only subagent strategy.
External research runs only after a named local evidence gap and explicit bounded-research confirmation.
Refine, stage capabilities, subagents, research sources, and later decision/spec owners retain distinct authority; no advisory result promotes itself.
The result remains a refined research design and non-executed plan, not a product decision, security proof, implementation claim, or promotion authority.
The candidate envelope admits representative useful workflows, rejects authority amplification, and labels unknown enforcement honestly.
Every spawned subagent has a terminal join and close receipt, with evidence, residue, and reroute fields.

observability.signal_grouping: dispatch_id, step_id, capability_ref, role_id, status, artifact, validation, blocker, residue, authorization

boundaries.contract: Consumers receive frames, handles, decisions, ledgers, and artifacts without taking lifecycle ownership from their producers.
Subagents return advisory evidence and counterexamples; Refine owns join, repair, synthesis, and unresolved residue.
External evidence may fill a named gap after approval but cannot override repository authority or become canonical by import.
All writes remain inside this refinement-run folder; canonical product and decision artifacts are read-only.

authority.execution: operator confirmation plus current parent-native runtime
authority.validation: dispatch-spec for route shape; each stage capability for its native artifact
authority.evidence: source owners and terminal stage/subagent receipts
authority.promotion: future RWO, ACI, security, and product decision owners outside this run

state_namespaces.write_policy: Only run-local evidence and stage artifacts may be written before a separately approved next route.

promotion_splits.rule: A separate owner-controlled decision or authoring route must review and accept the result; Refine cannot promote it.

promotion_guardrails: No V1 capability envelope becomes an accepted product decision in this run.
No declaration of permission is represented as physical enforcement proof.
No recursive-authority prohibition or allowance is promoted without its owner decision.
No runtime, capability, sandbox, scheduler, adapter, policy, or canonical specification is changed.
